headline: Central Fronts Stir as Base Lines Shift
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the central fighting has sharpened rather than settled. LinnMercy remains the chief flashpoint, with 36 strategic-base events in the latest day and six in the last two hours; its ledger stands at nine Colonial, one Warden, and one neutral holding. PalantineBerm has recorded 47 daily events, while MarbanHollow shows 29 and now lists four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral base. WeatheredExpanse has likewise grown busier, reaching 37 events, with six Warden, one Colonial, and two neutral holdings. Gutter has doubled its recent activity to 14 daily events, chiefly around Lost Kaivo, Suojus, and Kuoppa. Stonecradle is an emerging concern, posting 13 events, seven Colonial bases, and two neutral positions, with casualties and enlistments accelerating in the latest comparison. FarranacCoast has seen five base events and heavy recent enlistment, though its battle tempo is cooling. Most other regions report no strategic-base movement, and the war remains unresolved below the 34-town victory mark.
